summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for OpticLink Telemetry & Remote Stream Studio, a Dual-Mode WebRTC Remote Camera, Screen Share, and Telemetry Progressive Web Application (PWA) powered by Firebase Cloud Firestore. Covers confirmed user decisions, Clean Industrial Slate adaptive theme, Zero-Polling Firestore Presence, Pre-Warmed Multiplex WebRTC Engine (<250ms connect), Dual-Engine Anti-Blank-Screen WebP fallback pipeline, full stream lifecycle controls, 15s RAM Time-Machine replay, Smart Motion HUD, Screen-Share Laser Guide, 4-Layer Security (Master PIN & 6-Digit Pairing), and Local Loopback testing mode.
